mitigation: The resolver must match keys case-insensitively and the Key dropdown must be scoped per scenario; raw values stay untouched

risk: duckdb arrow and DBI were not installed in the R environment and had to be added
mitigation: Record duckdb and DBI as required dependencies; arrow can be dropped since Parquet was rejected

risk: Shiny holding 155.9 MB per session with plain CSV does not scale with concurrent users
mitigation: DuckDB removes the in-session footprint entirely

risk: Parquet string predicates cannot be pushed down so key filters take about 3 seconds
mitigation: Parquet rejected; DuckDB answers the same query in 0.005 s

mitigation: Add a build step that regenerates the database from the R6 CSV artifacts and records the run id

risk: Phase 2 (CPU and IOPS) adds approximately 6.02M rows

risk: Benchmark byproducts occupy about 506 MB on disk (partitioned CSV and Parquet)
mitigation: Both are reproducible from bench_storage.R and may be deleted after review

risk: DuckDB stores extensions in a temp directory by default
mitigation: Connect with shared_home = FALSE as done in the benchmark; no extension is required for these queries
